exposure: Maternal sodium valproate use during pregnancy
outcome: Spontaneous partial regression of corneal tumors
cohort: The study involved a single 14-month-old child diagnosed with Fetal Valproate Spectrum Disorder, whose mother took sodium valproate throughout her pregnancy.
finding: The study found that bilateral grade III corneal dermoids may be an ocular anomaly associated with Fetal Valproate Spectrum Disorder and that these tumors can undergo spontaneous partial regression over 5 years.
